preconditions.description: The length of the string n and the length of the minimal unique substring k must satisfy 1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 100,000.
Both n and k must have the same parity.

postconditions.description: The output string must have a length of n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: min(len(set(stdout[i:i+k])) for i in range(n-k+1)) == k
postconditions.description: The length of the minimal unique substring of the output string must be exactly k.
